project.name: clotho
project.productType: consumer web app: personal finance simulation for young Canadians

design.colorMode: light and dark (prefers-color-scheme plus data-theme override)

motion.rule: motion only to show cause and effect (river morph, number changes); respect prefers-reduced-motion

patterns: questions as rows of tappable chips
one short line of copy per section

must: No red anywhere; status is never shown by colour alone
Counts, not percentages, in headlines (for example 612 of 1,000)
Little text: one short line per section, details behind taps
WCAG AA contrast, full keyboard use, visible focus
Usable at 375 px and on a 1080p projector
Canadian spelling, calm and warm voice
avoid: Words: behind, should have, too late, at risk, danger, doom, recommended
Decorative gradients, glass effects, external fonts or CDNs (must work offline)

decisions.decision: All intake questions on one 'About you' screen, mostly as chip groups (pattern from 21st 'Chip Group': pressed buttons, roving focus, check grows in), rebuilt in plain CSS without a motion library. The same component sits beside the river as 'Change your answers' so answers still move the river.
decisions.source: user request: ask everything at once, less text
